name: Graph Catalogue
description: Discover, inspect and run approved Dynamo graphs.
trigger: A user asks for a standard process the firm has already scripted.
acceptanceTest: The run report names every item changed and every item skipped, with a reason.
A reviewer can confirm the change in the model without reading the graph.
Re-running with the same requestKey produces no second set of changes.

writes.blastRadius: Whatever the catalogued graph does to the open model.
